description.p: Porter is a native resident desktop assistant built on Cua Driver and Jev. It provides a full Aurora Dark control center, a compact command bar, hands-free voice input, and bounded desktop automation.
Porter can speak its replies through a local text-to-speech endpoint, pauses the microphone while speaking, and exposes speech enable, model, voice, and language controls in Voice & Audio settings.
First Porter preview: native Aurora Dark UI, resident Cua/Jev runtime, hands-free voice, global shortcut, secure credentials, diagnostics, guided Driver maintenance, and Debian packaging.
